en: Sepia-toned view of a grand neoclassical urban ensemble with colonnaded buildings, palm-lined street, tram tracks, early motor vehicles and pedestrians. On the right are two prominent classical-style buildings with pediments and statues atop tall columns, and in the background another similar building. The scene is a formal city avenue or square. Greek text appears along the bottom center and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is printed across the lower right.
